testsuite.name: com.meshcoreone.android.core.ble.AndroidGattApi33Test

testcase.name: native no callback MTU times out and all receiver registrations are removed
real notifications retain equal empty and unknown frames before a receiver attaches
late native callback after reconnect cannot acknowledge the new GATT write
status133 is a retained GATT failure not guessed pairing or competing app
real characteristic and descriptor write overloads match the actual API level
Bluetooth power broadcast reads actual state and closes the current handle
real descriptor rejects wrong object even when UUID matches
modern platform entry points reject unsupported actual API levels before invoking them
service changed invalidates old attributes without any hidden cache refresh
bond broadcast never trusts a supplied PIN or peer extras
connection status eight is HCI timeout with or without an active write
real write command path requires firmware evidence and preserves whole frames
permission revocation on a callback is explicit rather than an empty receive stream
permission denial is checked before native connectGatt or receiver registration
real nonzero authentication callback status preserves typed recovery
real too small MTU is rejected and requested MTU never substitutes for it
API appropriate notification signature avoids duplicate legacy and modern delivery
native cleanup attempts close after disconnect permission failure and surfaces both causes
mixed case address uses canonical uppercase in actual Android device lookup
native adapter absence is a distinct unavailable capability
descriptor rejection is terminal even if local routing was enabled
real RSSI callback retains signed dBm and reports failure without treating it as bond proof
unsolicited MTU change fails closed rather than overstating frame capability
local notification rejection is not a successful CCCD subscription
real adapter binds a synchronous connect callback only to the returned GATT
immediate write rejection or status failure cannot report success
callback notification bytes are copied at entry across the platform looper queue
bond required returns system pairing recovery without silently creating a bond
real write rejects wrong GATT characteristic and operation callback kinds
an early wrong GATT cannot become the adopted connection handle
